en.headline: Small LED fire dragon performs at Victoria Park this weekend
en.dek: A children’s LED dragon takes the soccer pitches at 7pm on Saturday and Sunday, as the Mid-Autumn creative market also opens in the park this evening.
body: A small LED fire dragon will perform at 7pm tonight and on Sunday at soccer pitches 5 and 6 in Victoria Park, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said, giving families an early look at the Tai Hang tradition before the full incense-lit dance later in the week.

The main Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance still runs from 24 to 26 September around Wun Sha Street, with a late appearance inside Victoria Park on Mid-Autumn night, 25 September. The weekend LED shows are staged as a shorter, child-friendly preview.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Mid-Autumn creative market also opens in the park this evening, running from 6.30pm to 11pm on Saturdays and Sundays until 27 September. Lanterns across the pitches remain lit from 6.30pm to 11pm.

Admission is free. Organisers have asked visitors not to bring open-flame lanterns, alcohol or metal balloons, and to follow crowd-control instructions. They also suggested coming on nights other than 25 September if people want to avoid the busiest crowds.

zh.headline: 維園今明兩晚演小型LED火龍 中秋市集同日開檔
zh.dek: 旅發局指今晚及週日晚上7時於維園五、六號足球場演小型LED火龍；康文署中秋創意市集今晚6時半起開放。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，今晚及週日晚上7時，維多利亞公園五號及六號足球場會上演小型LED火龍，讓家庭在大坑正日舞火龍前，先觀看較短的親子版本。
大坑舞火龍主場仍於9月24日至26日在浣紗街一帶舉行，中秋正日（9月25日）晚上更會進入維園演出。今個周末的LED場次屬較短的預演。
康樂及文化事務署的中秋創意市集亦由今晚起開放，時間為晚上6時半至11時，逢周六、日舉行至9月27日。園內綵燈繼續於晚上6時半至11時亮燈。
活動免費入場。主辦單位提醒勿攜帶明火燈籠、酒精類飲品或金屬氣球，並須遵從現場人流管制。當局亦建議若想避開人潮，可選擇中秋正日以外的晚上到訪。
